name: FEVER-VitaminC LLM Benchmark
description: A reliability test bench evaluating local LLMs (Qwen 2.5 7B, Llama 3.2, Phi-4 Mini) on FEVER & VitaminC across 4 axes: correctness, stability, distractor robustness, and edit sensitivity. Includes a live Wikipedia RAG pipeline (TF-IDF), an interactive Streamlit dashboard, and a 162-test CI/CD suite verified across Python 3.10–3.13.
